Loop Start.description: Clock engine for queue-based looping. It always reads start_index from the current prompt (rewritten by Loop Trigger before auto-queue) and writes current_index/total/session into shared state for Loop Trigger.

start_index.name: start_index
start_index.tooltip: Starting index used when you manually click Queue

List Item Extractor.description: Extracts one item from a list by index. Raises immediately on empty lists or out-of-range indexes.

list.name: list
list.tooltip: Any list-like input, including multiline text

Loop Trigger.description: End-of-graph trigger. Re-queues until current_index + 1 reaches total by rewriting Loop Start.start_index in the next prompt and writing next_index/total/session metadata; duplicate triggers in the same cycle are deduplicated. Reports progress in the node panel.

any.name: any
any.tooltip: Execution dependency, usually connected from a Save node
